facts.material: not stated (electronic device with speaker, plastic housing)
facts.function: reproduces stored predator calls to lure animals

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9208 names 'decoy calls of all kinds'; chapter 92 note 1 does not exclude a self-contained call
GRI 3(a): if 8519 (sound reproducing apparatus) is also arguable, the eo nomine 'decoy calls' is the more specific description
GRI 6: 9208.90 other; 9208.90.00.80 other than musical instruments

rejected_alternatives.reason: general sound reproducing apparatus; less specific than decoy calls of all kinds for a device designed for hunting calls
not a video game accessory or toy

missing_facts: whether it is a self-contained unit with built-in speaker or separate remote/speaker
classification.rationale: Heading 9208 covers decoy calls of all kinds; a battery-operated device designed to reproduce predator calls for hunting is a decoy call. No on-point ruling was found in the tool results, and 8519.81 sound reproducing apparatus remains an arguable alternative.
